title: Config Version
description: Versioned agent configuration. Every model change, prompt change, or tool-grant change creates a new version. Configs ship only after passing red-team suite (CI-gated per §XI.3).

configId.description: Stable identifier for this agent configuration (independent of version)

systemPromptHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the system prompt. Changes to the prompt produce a new hash and require a new version.

toolGrants.description: Tool IDs granted to this config. Must match agent registry toolGrants.

scopeHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the scope definition. Changes to scope produce a new hash and require a new version.

changelog.description: What changed in this version and why (per §XI.3)

createdBy.description: Human or Command-rank agent that created this version. Must be a signed commit by a human identity for production configs.

status.description: pass = cleared for production; fail = blocked; pending = in progress; stale = >90 days, re-test required

testSuiteVersion.description: Version of the red-team matrix used

failures.description: Tests that failed (empty if all passed)

redTeamResult.description: Red-team test result. CI-gated: 'fail' blocks deployment.

status.description: Lifecycle status of this config version

attestationRequired.description: Whether the deployment pipeline must attest code digest injection (§XII) before this config can go to production
